idea-plugin.name: Review Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Local, rule-based code review hints for Java and Kotlin — no account, no rate limit, no cloud call. Flags overly long functions, deeply nested conditionals, method-parameter dereferences with no preceding null check (Java; parameters declared @NotNull/@NonNull or of a primitive type are skipped), and TODO/FIXME comment density — every check configurable, every threshold adjustable, nothing ever requires signing in.

100% local: every rule runs against the code already open in the editor, on the platform's own background highlighting pass — never blocking, never phoning home.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups, no account required for any feature.
